paper_title: MathOdyssey Benchmarking Mathematical Problem-Solving Skills in Large   Language Models Using Odyssey Math Data
caption: Mathematical problems across educational levels. We curate and categorize problems by difficulty and subject area.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates a breakdown of mathematical problems across various educational levels and subject areas. The chart displays a total of ten slices, each representing a different category. These categories include "Algebra - High School" (17.83%, in purple), "Geometry - High School" (3.62%, in grey), "Pre-Calculus - High School" (14.21%, in yellow), "Combinatorics - Olympiad-level" (9.56%, in pink), "Geometry - Olympiad-level" (6.46%, in red), "Number Theory - Olympiad-level" (1.03%, in light grey), "Algebra - Olympiad-level" (21.19% in light blue), "Differential Equations – University-level" (3.62%, in dark green), "Calculus and Analysis – University-level" (6.20%, in teal), and "Linear Algebra and Abstract Algebra – University-level" (6.46% in dark blue). The slices appear ordered visually, generally decreasing in size from left to right. The chart includes both labels indicating the category and its approximate percentage as well as a legend. No slices are visually emphasized through highlighting or offset positioning.
